info.title: APDA Standings API
info.description: Machine-friendly endpoints for APDA standings, replay visualizations, school rosters, debater profiles, teams, tournaments, and the OTY scoring guide.

get.description: Discover the correction API, allowed fields, relations, constraints, and supported bulk operations.

post.description: Atomic bulk correction. Requires request_id UUID, reason, and 1–200 operations. Optional dry_run and expected_change_hash. See authenticated guide for examples.
Atomic bulk correction. Requires request_id UUID, reason, and 1–200 operations. Optional dry_run and expected_change_hash. See authenticated guide for examples.
Reverse a committed batch. Requires a fresh request_id and reason. Supports dry_run. Refuses conflicting later edits. Undo itself is a reversible change set.

get.description: Read uncached correction records, including synthetic/temporary identities. Filter by exposed scalar fields (exact or __in), q text search, limit and after cursor.

parameters.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only markers earned on/before this date are counted.
